name: Life spaceship 41eb5c62 on 3-uniform tiling k3-010
description: A period-38 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-010, with touching neighbours, 8 to 24 cells, moving four lattice steps every 38 generations (2c/19). It runs the same way in the 2,048 rules from B3/S23 to B3,8,9,10/S2,3,8,9,10. JETCARP's Life census met it in 23 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
